label: Project-generated structural field inventory, not an original author codebook
source_description:
Data for Working Memory Develops at a Similar Rate Across Diverse Stimuli

- The data files include the raw data (dat_all) and collapsed data per participant (dat_..._Unstacked). The data files include pre-analyses of the span using the all-or-nothing unit scoring system or the partial credit unit scoring system.

- The ratios between the different types of spans are pre-calculated in dat_..._Unstacked, as well as the z-scores.

- The column names are self-explanatory.
